text: The UEBA system flagged VicePresident Zenaida Carol Snow's activity for the week of 2010-W32 due to unusual volume of attachment data sent to external recipients. Specifically, 54.57 MB of email attachments were sent, which is clearly above their usual range of 23.37 MB and even higher than their highest in the prior 12 weeks of 45.10 MB. This suggests that there may be an unusual or unexplained increase in the amount of data being shared externally.
